rationale: Candidate e0c1166eb5a3fe9340ad3e496331f73e247e79d5d10c698c28bdd06f51cecef5 (bundle trial-4bdb465d41-param-0bfb4c5a) is accepted with the memory objective improved (peak_allocated_bytes 204,905,472 vs parent 281,975,808, -27.3%; original reference 281,975,808) while images_per_second 7824.29 exceeds the 7120.31 floor (1.044x the 7495.06 original baseline), and quality passes. The only unresolved uncertainty in the actual evidence is route authenticity: the declared route 'chunked_stem_composite' (count 2) is candidate-reported telemetry, framework_fallbacks=0 only rules out framework-level fallback, and the endpoint interpretation explicitly asks for corroboration via traces or actual exception evidence. The torch collector already ran (coverage.json: 88 cuda_kernels, 88 associated, 0 ambiguous), so trace-side corroboration exists and a second trace (nsys or execution_timeline) would add nothing for this single-stream inference path. candidate_diagnostics on this exact candidate supplies the complementary evidence: handled exceptions with propagated library traceback locations or False returns inside candidate files would reveal silent internal fallback that the route label and framework counters cannot show. Communication collectors (nccl_tuning, collective_calibration) are not applicable per observations.json ('single-device task'); device_telemetry is device-wide NVML sampling and cannot see torch-allocator peaks; python_runtime perturbs execution and addresses a host-dispatch question that is not observed; binding_cost is unnecessary given direct binding with no functional replacements and no observed throughput cost, and it would force runs in subsequent candidate resource feedback. Revision is set to the evaluated candidate so the diagnostic run targets this exact candidate in its separate worker.
